name: Reza Rassool
office: Santa Clarita Community College District, Member of the Board of Trustees, Trustee Area 1

items.text: Reza Rassool, a University of Washington affiliate professor and retired technology executive, is running for the Santa Clarita Community College District Board of Trustees, Area 1. His campaign prioritizes affordability, quality, and supporting transfer, certificates, and workforce training. At a forum, he raised concerns about online enrollment, AI’s effect on the future of work, and student outcomes, and proposed an industrial residency model connecting local businesses with campus programs.
